body:
issue-worker-high: escalation to `effort:max`. I did not claim the issue and I did not write code.

What I found:

- Part 1 (presets) is `effort:high` work. It needs a preset data file in `assets/`, a loader, new `SoftJaw` fields (bolt centres, screw, material), the grouped picker in the UI, the MCP and script parameters, and a structural UI test.
- Part 2 (bolt holes) needs counterbored holes through a closed jaw mesh. `crates/app/src/accessory/mesh.rs` draws all holes solid today. A real hole needs a polygon-with-hole extrusion or a mesh boolean. The screws must also become fixture solids in the counterbores.
- Part 3 (nest from the part) needs these new algorithms:
  - a section of the part mesh at the grip height;
  - a clearance offset of that outline;
  - a closed jaw mesh with the pocket cut from the top;
  - a jaw-cutting setup that uses the jaw pair as stock.
- The collision check of a nested jaw mesh already exists (#1530, `crates/app/tests/carried_fixture_shape.rs`). Only the generation of the nest is new.

The total is new geometry algorithms in several crates. This is `effort:max` by the AGENTS.md table.

Recommended split, for the next worker or the maintainer:

1. Presets and the Custom dialog (part 1): `effort:high`.
2. Bolt holes, counterbores and screw solids (part 2): `effort:high`, at the safety floor.
3. Nest generation from the part outline, and the jaw-as-stock setup (part 3): `effort:max`.

Held work: none. No branch was pushed.
